Title: Azure Event Grid is now in public preview for Azure Cache for Redis

Body.Content:
Azure Cache for Redis now offers preview support of integration with Azure Event Grid, a service to manage routing of events to any destination. In this preview, Azure Cache for Redis events will be triggered when a client exports, imports, or scales their cache instance, as well as when Redis updates are performed. These events can be triggered using Event Grid to subscribers such as Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, or your own http listener.

To get started, read the Azure Cache for Redis Event Grid Overview documentation to learn more about this announcement and to subscribe to events using the Azure portal, PowerShell, or Azure CLI.
